title: Instant Oxygen Refill
description: Makes the oxygen refill immediately, like in pre-1.13 versions.
body:
Are you annoyed by how slowly oxygen refills?
This mod restores the pre-1.13 oxygen behavior.
Now it refills instantly!
Additionally, it makes water breathing potions and conduits fully refill oxygen instead of just maintaining it.

The mod is for NeoForge.
It works straight away, no configuration required.

Feel free to use it in your modpack!
